en.html:
Wolf"I search for one thing, and instead I find you. My search has developed its own opinion."
Wolf"Every time, you appear without warning. Is advance notice beneath your artistic dignity?"
Chachamaru"Apun said less talking. This is more."
Wolf"People nowadays! One asks a perfectly elaborate question, and receives this microscopic answer. Explain the economy."
Chachamaru"Bas kar. First save some words on your side."
Wolf"Nonsense. You have confused brevity with intelligence, as the unintelligent so often do."
Chachamaru"Only when it suits you, full sensible! Apun should get angry, but leave it for now."
Chachamaru"The Princess has awakened. Came to tell you that."
Wolf"Oh?"
Wolf"That information is certain?"
Chachamaru"Apun's eyes miss nothing. Only possible error: a hundred and eighty degrees."
Wolf"Good. Then we may rely on it."
Chachamaru"Arre, where is your correction? Apun supplies the nonsense, apun must correct it also? Tereko no work left?"
Wolf"You wish to be an entire conversation by yourself? A most economical ambition."
Chachamaru"No, that's not what I mean."
Chachamaru"See, plain reply only. No twist, no nothing. Apun has wasted the whole chance."
Wolf"Chup, fool."

Chachamaru"Full bullying is going on here."
Wolf"The Princess will come to Fudaraku Castle at the appointed time?"
Chachamaru"Yes. All set."
Wolf"Repeating the attempt will not be easy. This time we cannot afford a mistake."
Wolf"You are certain?"
Chachamaru"Certain."
Wolf"Good. Now, some proper appreciation of my conversation would also be in order."
Chachamaru"Yeah, heard you."
Wolf"Hearing is not the same as appreciating, zara samajhiye. A masterpiece can fall on a fool's ears also."
Chachamaru"Then let it fall. Apun's not appreciating."
Wolf"At least find a few words worthy of the words you are refusing. Let your refusal show some gratitude."
Chachamaru"Kaiko? Say thank you for being told to shut up? Stop this nonsense."
ｅｔｃ／巡回兵士"...Who goes there?"
Chachamaru"..."

Chachamaru"Phew. Finally, some peace."
Wolf"Entirely your fault, of course."
Chachamaru"Ha, proof kaiko needed? Culprit you already picked."
Chachamaru"English, Yamato, both full fluent. You really come from GermanyGermany?"
Wolf"Germany is my homeland. But I have spent even longer traveling the world, so my attachment to home is rather faint."
Wolf"One country cannot be expected to contain an opinion of my dimensions."
Chachamaru"Earth has no place for you, then."
Wolf"Given international circumstances, and the nature of my specialty, knowing languages is only natural."
Chachamaru"Achha."
Wolf"Now that ability of yours—to appear and disappear so suddenly. Most impressive."
Wolf"Can one acquire it through training?"
Chachamaru"Sure. First do ten thousand push-ups."
Wolf"Ten thousand? Very well, then—"
Chachamaru"Nahin, joke! Apun was joking! Sorry, take the whole suggestion back."
Wolf"Hmm. Since you have apologized, I shall overlook it."

茶々丸 「……ふー」
ウォルフ 「君の愚かしい失態でプチピンチであった。 　気をつけたまえよ？」
茶々丸 「怒る気もしねぇー」
茶々丸 「にしてもおめー英語が達者だよな。大和語 もだけどさ。 　ほんとに独逸ドイツ人か？」
ウォルフ 「独逸は故郷には違いないがね、そこで暮ら した時間より世界を旅して回っていた時間の 方が長い。 　母国など有って無いようなものだ」
ウォルフ 「強いて言えばパンツ脱いだ少女が住まう国 こそ我が母国――」
茶々丸 「おめーの居場所地球上にないからな」
ウォルフ 「ま、現在の国際情勢と僕の専門を鑑みれば 英語と大和語に熟達するのはシンプルな論理 的帰結でしかないよ」
茶々丸 「そか」
ウォルフ 「しかし君の能力も便利なものだね。 　突然現れるのも咄嗟に隠れるのも自在じゃ ないか」
ウォルフ 「それ僕も修行とかすれば何とかなるかな？」
茶々丸 「さぁ？　なるんじゃねえの？ 　とりあえず腕立て伏せ一万回からやってみ」
ウォルフ 「本当だな！　やるぞ!? 　それで身につかなかったらパンツ脱がす!!」
茶々丸 「うわーごめんなさい！　嘘つきました！ 　あんたやるったら本当にやりそうだし抵抗 するのも無理っぽいから勘弁してください！」
ウォルフ 「ちっ、仕方ない。 　今回は視姦だけで許してやろう」
